description: Delta Electricity Sustainability Report is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. Delta Electricity Sustainability Report 2009 Note: This resource was originally published on opengov.nsw.gov.au. The OpenGov website has been retired. If you have any questions, please contact the Agency Services team at transfer@mhnsw.au Agency Delta Electricity. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Delta Electricity. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
